summary_ja: ECMWF AIFSの2025年運用開始、2026年v2更新、51-member ensemble、約6 TB/日の出力、物理IFSとの併用を追加しました。AI推論だけでなくend-to-end serviceを評価します。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds AIFS operations from 2025, the 2026 v2 upgrade, its 51-member ensemble, roughly 6 TB/day output, and coexistence with the physics-based IFS. Evaluation covers the end-to-end service rather than AI inference alone. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_ja: AIFS Single・ENSの運用実績と物理系併用
items.name_en: Operational AIFS Single and ENS alongside physics forecasting
items.statement_ja: ECMWFはAIFS Singleを2025年2月25日、51個の予報から成るAIFS ENSを同年7月1日に運用化し、両者を2026年5月12日にv2へ更新しました。公式資料では、予報は1日4回、6時間刻みで15日先まで生成され、SingleとENSを合わせて約6 TB/日のdataを出力します。AIFS ENSは当初31 kmで、9 kmの物理based ensemble IFSは高解像度fieldとcoupled Earth-system processに不可欠と説明されました。したがってAI予報を物理simulationの単純な置換とは扱いません。
items.statement_en: ECMWF placed AIFS Single into operations on 25 February 2025 and the 51-member AIFS ENS on 1 July 2025, then upgraded both to v2 on 12 May 2026. Official material says forecasts are produced four times daily at six-hour steps to 15 days, and Single plus ENS produce about 6 TB of data per day. AIFS ENS initially ran at 31 km while the 9 km physics-based ensemble IFS remained indispensable for high-resolution fields and coupled Earth-system processes. AI forecasting is therefore not treated as a simple replacement for physical simulation.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 気象・防災向け整備では、学習GPUだけでなく、operational analysis、51-member ensemble、期限内配信、約6 TB/日の生成data、物理系fallbackを一つのserviceとして評価します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Weather and disaster planning should evaluate operational analysis, a 51-member ensemble, deadline-bound dissemination, roughly 6 TB/day of generated data, and physics-based fallback as one service rather than counting training GPUs alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 対象解像度、変数、ensemble数、予報頻度、deadline、品質指標を固定してend-to-end測定する。
data assimilation、初期値、物理model併用、障害時fallback、長期archiveの資源を含める。
ECMWFの運用値を日本の観測網・防災serviceへ直接外挿せず、国内workflowで検証する。
adoption_conditions_en: Fix resolution, variables, ensemble count, forecast cadence, deadlines, and quality metrics for end-to-end measurement.
Include resources for data assimilation, initial conditions, physics-model coexistence, failure fallback, and long-term archives.
Do not extrapolate ECMWF operating values directly to Japanese observing and disaster services; validate domestic workflows.
items.timing_en: Operational since 2025; v2 operational from May 2026
